title: Frontend motion library selection
when_to_use: Use when the task matches this technical capability.
method: Use CSS first for simple transitions.
Prefer Motion for React state/layout/gestures; GSAP for complex timelines/scroll/SVG; Anime.js for a compact general JS engine; React Spring when physics is central.
Verify current library docs before implementing APIs.
failure_modes: Choosing by demo aesthetics instead of interaction model
